name: Avatar of Shulkers
description:
You reflect projectiles and take -25% damage from them.
Sneak punching the block below you closes your shell until you stop sneaking. While your shell is closed, you take -25% damage and are immune to knockback, jumping teleports you to a random nearby location, and fired arrows become shulker bullets. If they hit a target who was already levitating, the levitation is cleansed instead, but the bullet and the target’s fall both deal 4x damage.
